scientific_null.name: no_incremental_relational_predictive_content
scientific_null.restriction: incremental relational conditional-mean coefficients are zero under the declared outcome DGP
scientific_null.important_finite_sample_note: This restriction does not imply zero finite-sample forecast-loss difference between fitted nested methods. The bootstrap must reproduce that estimator-induced finite-sample difference rather than center the loss differential at zero.

why_this_candidate: The retained-loss origin MBB cannot reproduce nested estimation uncertainty.
The complete rolling schedule has dependence induced by overlapping training windows.
Refitting the exact fixed-ridge, training-only-standardized estimator inside every bootstrap world directly preserves the estimator whose inference is being considered.
A whole-series bootstrap can preserve serial dependence across adjacent held-out blocks instead of treating origin means as the only stochastic object.

feature_conditioning.requirement: Must explicitly justify strict exogeneity or replace this with a joint feature/outcome bootstrap before formal approval.
feature_conditioning.do_not_assume: Observed feature paths are not automatically exogenous merely because the current estimator does not regress the outcome on lagged outcomes.

outcome_model.restricted_structure: fit the declared NonRelationalContext outcome equation under the null restriction
outcome_model.relational_increment: excluded from bootstrap DGP under the scientific null
outcome_model.error_generation: dependence-preserving residual/innovation resampling with a declared block mechanism
outcome_model.heteroskedasticity: must be preserved or explicitly modeled in bootstrap residual scaling

parameter_source.candidate_policy: frozen and declared before examining confirmatory forecast improvement
open_choice: restricted-model fit on the first eligible training span only
restricted-model fit on the full non-evaluation calibration span
parameter_source.approval_requirement: The chosen policy must be fixed before the scientific result is inspected and must be included in the procedure specification digest.

refit_protocol: Generate one contiguous bootstrap series covering every index required by the first through last RH-006 rolling origin.
Preserve the observed feature path when the conditional-exogeneity contract is approved.
Generate the bootstrap outcome path under the restricted null DGP.
For every origin, rerun exact training-only feature standardization.
For every origin, rerun exact fixed-ridge fitting with the declared ridge lambda.
For every origin, recompute both NonRelationalContext and RelationalAugmented forecasts.
Recompute the complete target-level squared-loss differential vector.
Aggregate the same origin-level block means D[o].
Compute the same studentized origin statistic T.
Use the empirical bootstrap distribution of T* for the one-sided critical value.

dependence.cross_origin_source_2: serially dependent outcome errors crossing held-out block boundaries
dependence.within_origin_source: serial dependence among held-out target losses
dependence.candidate_block_policy: retain L=3 as the first fixed design anchor; investigate dependence-derived alternatives only under an ex ante rule

statistic.studentizer: Bartlett long-run variance of ordered origin means with fixed predeclared bandwidth K

critical_distinction.loss_level_centering: Not used in the preferred candidate.
critical_distinction.null_reference: Generated by the restricted bootstrap DGP plus full rolling refits.
critical_distinction.reason: This lets the null distribution contain the finite-sample nested-estimator risk asymmetry observed under beta_relational = 0.

negative_controls: independent-feature randomization must not create an apparent relational effect under the restricted null
stronger serial dependence must not produce uncontrolled size inflation
changing ridge lambda must not silently alter the bootstrap null specification
removing relational channels must collapse the incremental comparison as expected
approval_gates: Exact estimator equivalence between observed and bootstrap refits.
Declared and replayable null-DGP parameter source.
Dependence-preserving bootstrap validated under serial correlation.
Monte Carlo size calibration at substantially larger replication counts than the current pilot.
No result-dependent block length, null DGP, or method switching.
Independent reproduction from frozen source, manifest, and RNG seed.

literature_boundary.supporting_reference: Doko Tchatoka & Haque (2023), Journal of Forecasting, DOI 10.1002/for.2987
literature_boundary.additional_reference: Clark & McCracken (2015), Journal of Econometrics, DOI 10.1016/j.jeconom.2014.06.016
literature_boundary.mapping_statement: The cited literature supports the general nested-bootstrap direction, but does not by citation alone establish validity for RH-006 fixed-ridge, training-only-standardized rolling refits. This artifact is a new candidate bridge, not a validity claim.
